width.ownerInstruction: Keep at 20.16; alternatives are historical comparisons only

method.projection: Frozen BALL-PHYS at 240 Hz, independent bounded triangular yaw/elevation errors; no frame or keeper colliders. Deterministic physical grid and Jacobian push-forward.
method.controlledTargeting: At fixed speed, a lab-only pre-contact elevation solve hits the target. It is not the charge-selected apex resolver. Approved-charge mode is separately available.
method.spatialSigma: Local Jacobian approximation, not empirical standard deviation
method.support: Bounds from the deterministic projection mesh; unresolved non-crossing cells retain separate probability mass and are not renormalized.
